newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Energy Africa in Gabon oil exploration deal.
newsitem.headline: Energy Africa in Gabon oil exploration deal.

text.p: South African oil company Energy Africa Ltd said on Monday it had entered into a partnership agreement with the Republic of Gabon to participate in exploration and development projects there.
No further details were given in the brief announcement.
Managing director John Bentley told Reuters on Monday that details of the deal would probably be announced by the middle of the week.
"The announcement is just to say we have done it to satisfy stock exchange obligations. We will announce further details very shortly, probably by Wednesday," Bentley said.
Energy Africa said the agreement was initiated last November at the time of the state visit to South Africa of Gabon President El Hadj Omar Bongo. Bentley said it was finalised over the weekend.
Energy Africa is already involved in oil activities throughout Africa, including exploration in Angola, and production operations offshore Congo.
